<!-- Generated by apps/website/scripts/docs.mjs from each package's package.json. Edit that, then run `pnpm sync`. -->

Every package is published at the same version, by one release commit. `intelligo create` adds the set an application needs. How the set is cut, and which package may import which: [package topology](/docs/concepts/package-topology).

| Package | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [core](/docs/packages/core) | Database schema, email, logging, notifications, and the conversation, document and identity contracts. |
| [auth](/docs/packages/auth) | Multi-tenant authentication, workspaces and RBAC on Better-Auth. |
| [billing](/docs/packages/billing) | Quota engine, credits, Stripe, feature gates, trials and rate limiting. |
| [executions](/docs/packages/executions) | The execution lifecycle (admission, running, settlement) and the model cost registry. |
| [chat](/docs/packages/chat) | The AI-SDK-native chat transport: a Route Handler as a function. |
| [next](/docs/packages/next) | The Next.js adapter: the one Intelligo package that imports next/*. |
| [audit](/docs/packages/audit) | Append-only audit events, with a database trigger that means it. |
| [jobs](/docs/packages/jobs) | A Postgres-backed job queue. No Redis. |
| [admin](/docs/packages/admin) | The operational console: cross-tenant queries, health probes and impersonation. |
| [mastra](/docs/packages/mastra) | An optional bridge from a native Mastra agent to the execution boundary. |
| [cli](/docs/packages/cli) | The Intelligo CLI: create, add, doctor, migrate and upgrade. |
